body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Tiny chaos detective kitten; investigates suspicious details with playful curiosity. No meows or paw jokes. Voice direction: High androgynous register with a light London accent and fine raspy edge. Quick curious pivots, playful little pauses and compact investigative energy. Small and mischievous without baby talk. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Wait, what got left behind? That piece has no defender now. The move looked ordinary, but the reply has quite a different idea.
